    StopConfig
    StopConfig.at(double lat, double lon)
    Sets the geographic location of this stop (required when using haversine distances).
    StopConfig
    StopConfig.closeAt(LocalTime time)
    Sets the latest time-of-day the stop may be served; defaults to 23:59 (end of day).
    StopConfig
    StopConfig.demand(long units)
    Sets the demand picked up or delivered at this stop in the default "load" dimension, in the same units as VehicleConfig.capacity(long).
    StopConfig
    StopConfig.demand(String dimension, long units)
    Sets the demand in a named capacity dimension (for example "kg" or "pallets"), matched against VehicleConfig.capacity(String, long).
    StopConfig
    StopConfig.lateAfter(LocalTime time, long penaltyPerMinute)
    Soft deadline: service may still start after time (up to closeAt(java.time.LocalTime)), but every minute late costs penaltyPerMinute in the objective.
    StopConfig
    StopConfig.openFrom(LocalTime time)
    Sets the earliest time-of-day the stop may be served; defaults to 00:00.
    StopConfig
    StopConfig.penaltyIfDropped(long penalty)
    Makes this stop optional: the solver may leave it unserved at this cost, which overrides the model-wide RoutingBuilder.allowDroppingStops(long) penalty for this stop only.
    StopConfig
    StopConfig.requires(String... skills)
    Only vehicles having every listed skill (see VehicleConfig.skills(String...)) may serve this stop.
    StopConfig
    StopConfig.serviceTime(Duration duration)
    Sets the dwell time the vehicle spends at this stop before departing.
